in_sanskrit.name: Nenu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Night, darkness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nenu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Nenu translates to 'night' or 'darkness'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Nanda, also known as Nenu, was the foster mother of Lord Krishna. She was the embodiment of motherly love and protection.
